arabic text: HAYE QASIM, HAYE HAYE QASIM\nO QASIM, O QASIM!
english translation text: HAYE QASIM, HAYE HAYE QASIM\nO QASIM, O QASIM!

arabic text: MAULA KI SADA GOONJI, AY MERE JAWAN QASIM\nMILTA HI NAHI TERE, LASHE KA PATA QASIM
english translation text: THE IMAM’S (A.S.) CALL ECHOED,\nO MY YOUNG QASIM!\nI CANNOT FIND YOUR BODY O QASIM

arabic text:
KAMSIN HE MAGAR SHERON, JESA HE JIGAR ISKA
SARDARE JAWANANE, JANNAT HE PADAR ISKA
KESE HO BHALA TERE, AWSAF BAYAN QASIM
O QASIM!
english translation text: HE IS VERY YOUNG BUT HE IS AS BRAVE AS A LION,\nHIS FATHER IS THE CHIEF OF THE YOUTH OF PARADISE,\nI CAN’T PRAISE YOU ENOUGH,

arabic text: SENE SE LAGATE HAIN, ROTE HUWE KEHTE HAIN,\nAYE LAAL MERE QASIM, RUKHSAT TUMHE KARTE HAIN\nDHOONDOONGA BHALA TUMKO, AB JAKE KAHAN QASIM
english translation text: THE IMAM (A.S.) HOLDS THE BODY OF QASIM AND WHILE CRYING HE SAYS,\nO’ MY QASIM I AM BIDDING YOU FAREWELL,\nNOW WHERE WILL I FIND YOU AFTER THIS

arabic text: RUKHSAT HUWE MADAR SE, BEHNO SE DUAEIN LI\nIS CHAAND SE CHEHRE KI, ZAINAB NE BALAYEIN LI\nHO JAOGE NAZRON SE, AB TUM BHI NIHA QASIMA
english translation text: QASIM BID FAREWELL TO HIS MOTHER AND SISTERS,\nBIBI ZAINAB (A.S.) PRAYED FOR HIS SAFETY,\nEVEN YOU WILL DISAPPEAR FROM MY SIGHT O’ QASIM

arabic text: CH(H)ALNI HUWA TEERON SE, MASOOM SA SHEHZADA\nPOORA KIYA QASIM NE, BABA SE KIYA WAADA\nAATE HAIN WAHAN MOLA GIRTE HAIN JAHAN QASIM
english translation text: THE BODY OF THE INNOCENT PRINCE WAS TORN INTO PIECES BY ARROWS,\nQASIM FULFILLED HIS PROMISE TO HIS FATHER,\nIMAM HUSSAIN (A.S) COMES TO THE PLACE WHERE QASIM’S BODY FELL

arabic text: BIKHRE HUWE KUCH TUKRE, MAIDA(N) SE UTHA TE HAIN\nYOON LASHAYE QASIM KI, GHATRI SI BANATE HAIN\nSEH PAYEGI GHAM TERA, KESE TERI MAA QASIM
english translation text: IMAM (A.S.) GATHERS THE PIECES OF QASIM’S BODY FROM THE BATTLEFIELD,\nHE WRAPS THEM IN A PIECE OF CLOTH,\nHOW WILL YOUR MOTHER ENDURE YOUR LOSS O’ QASIM!

arabic text: MATAM KI SADAEIN HE, KOHRAM QAYAMAT KA\nNOHA JO ZAFAR LIKHA, QASIM KI SHAHADAT KA\nHAR FARD HE MAJLIS MAIN, AB GIRYA KUNA QASIM
english translation text: THE SOUND OF WAILING ECHOES IN THE AIR, IT IS LIKE THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT,\nTHIS NOHA HAS MADE EVERYONE CRY FOR YOU O’ QASIM
